paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Comparison of the Improvement for 5-digit and 6-digit multiplication with as feedback model
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and accuracy improvement for two different digit lengths. The x-axis is labeled “Iteration” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 9, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. A blue line, marked with circular markers, represents the 6-digit data; starting at (0, 0), it increases to (1, 40), (2, 65), (3, 82), and plateaus at approximately (4, 85) for the remaining iterations up to (9, 85). An orange line, marked with square markers, represents the 5-digit data; it starts at (0, 0), ascends to (1, 65), (2, 70), (3, 78), and then plateaus at approximately (4, 82) for the remaining iterations from (4, 82) to (9, 82).
